title: T08 — One root command runs NERV and common tests, reusing exact evidence
goal: npm run gauntlet:all from the NERV root plans and runs NERV system packs and every common pack; by default it runs only new, changed or stale cases and reuses evidence whose identity matches exactly
acceptance: Plan shows per case, from `gauntlet pending`: run (new/changed/stale/identity mismatch) or reuse (report hash, age), with the aggregate time/output budget, before anything runs

Reuse requires the same case definition and profile (ledger), and Gauntlet's cache requires the same model/quantisation/runtime/settings, machine scenario and NERV source key before reusing executed evidence; any difference reruns the case; --fresh reruns all. Not met as first written: ledger coverage itself ignores runtime identity, machine scenario and the NERV source key (see escalation; owner decision pending)
NERV deterministic system cases always run (no model, cheap); model cases need explicit --confirm and the reviewed budget
A finished run records only admitted reports in the ledger through `gauntlet ledger record`
privacy: Neutral synthetic cases and private local reports only; no secrets, downloads or production effects.
validation: Fixtures for reuse, each identity mismatch, max age and --fresh; plan output without model execution
escalation: Default max age for reused model evidence is an owner decision (proposed 30 days)

Known limit 2026-11-11: ledger coverage is by case definition and profile (Gauntlet 0.6.0); runtime identity, machine scenario and the NERV source key are not part of it, so a NERV code change does not make system cases pending (CI still runs the NERV tests). Gauntlet's cache still requires them before reusing executed evidence. Binding them into coverage needs new ledger fields upstream: owner decision whether to plan it.

effort.basis: Owner request 2026-11-11: NERV always consumes every common Gauntlet pack plus its own, and a pack added or changed raises a run-new-tests item. Estimate, not a measurement.
